import React, {useEffect, useState} from 'react'; import { useParams } from 'react-router-dom'; import './employeeDetails.css'; function EmployeeDetails({getEmployeeByEmployeenr}) { const { id } = useParams(); // get the employeeID from the URL const [employees, setEmployees] = useState([]); useEffect(() => { getEmployeeByEmployeenr(id).then(data => setEmployees([data])); }, [getEmployeeByEmployeenr, id]); return (
{employees.map(employees => ( <>

{employees.firstname} {employees.lastname}

Email:
{employees.email}
Phone:
{employees.phone}
Address:
{employees.address.street} {employees.address.postcode}
{employees.address.city} {employees.address.country}
Position:
{employees.position}
Role:
{employees.role.name}
Employed Date:
{employees.employeddate}
Active:
{employees.isactive ? "Active" : "Not Active"}
))}
) } export default EmployeeDetails
